get.summary: Search aggregated slots by location GET API
get.description:
Get aggregate slots, as a GET API.
Minimum parameters is at least one of the following:
 - latitude/longitude (both is required)
 - postalCode
 - departmentEmrIds
 - npis
If latitude/longitude AND postalCode are passed in, postalCode will
take precedence. If a location (lat/long or postalCode) are passed in
with departmentEmrIds and/or npis, the results will be filtered
by departmentEmrIds and npis, respectively.

parameters.name: correlation-id
parameters.description: Unique id to correlate call logs between our microservices

parameters.name: clinicTypes
parameters.description: Clinic type filter. Separate multiple with commas. Case-insensitive.

parameters.name: daysOfSlots
parameters.description:
Allows use of getting slots by "page". Retrieve number of days that have slots
which can be nonconsecutive days for each "page".
Example: 3 entered returns 3 days of slots for today, tomorrow, and next Monday
as the dates between tomorrow and Monday do not have slots available.

parameters.name: departmentEmrIds
parameters.description: Department identifier filter.  Separate multiple with commas.

parameters.name: ehrInstances
parameters.description: EHR Instance Identifiers filter. Separate multiple with commas.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: End date of slots with yyyy-MM-dd format, end days will be certain days after start date if not present.

parameters.name: gender
parameters.description: Clinician gender filter

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description: Latitude of target visit location. "longitude" is required with this parameter.

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description: Longitude of target visit location. "latitude" is required with this parameter.

parameters.name: newOrEstablishedPatient
parameters.description: allows filter by slots of patient type of new or established patient. Both types will be returned by default.

parameters.name: npis
parameters.description: Clinician national provider identifier (NPI) filter. Pass in multiple by repeating param npi

parameters.name: postalCode
parameters.description: Zip code of the target visit location. Cannot use in tandem with latitude and longitude, postalCode will be used if both types are present.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Radius around postalCode or lat/long location in miles for slots

parameters.name: specialty
parameters.description: Clinician specialty filter. Currently only support one specialty.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Start date of slots with yyyy-MM-dd format, default set to today if not present.

parameters.name: userTimezone
parameters.description:
Optional param to pass in a timezone to change the dates and times in the response to a specific timezone.
If not present, defaults to presenting dates and times in the timezone of the hospital system's department or location.

parameters.name: visitTypeNames
parameters.description: Filter slots by visitTypeName. Separate multiple with commas. Case-insensitive.

parameters.name: product
parameters.description: Product filter.

modality.description: How the patient will engage with the provider for this visitType

slotDateTime.description: Date and time of the slot

duration.description: Duration of the slot in minutes
